rules: no declared typed arguments or required arguments for these views; opaque extra keys preserved
arrays of integral numbers 0..255; no Boolean, null, string, fraction, float-syntax literal such as 0.0, or coercion
malformed JSON, duplicate keys anywhere, wrong container/byte kinds or out-of-range bytes: error; no successful result
missing, short or overlong named arrays: incomplete; preserve raw and independent complete siblings
exact typed tuple; unsupported or missing/null selector: Unknown, raw-only, no formulas
preserve opaque family, variant and other keys; absent, null, zero and false remain distinct
context; raw; arguments if supplied; state; fields; physical=Unknown; qualified=false
raw if present; state; grade=Hypothesis; applicable number,label,flags,reserved,unmodeled,candidate_domain,alternatives
partial if supported and any required field incomplete; otherwise complete; unsupported Unknown
family/behavior Hypothesis; exact arithmetic calculation=Proven; physical Unknown; qualified=false
missing/unmapped/incomplete quantities have no number or label; unresolved candidate sibling does not force partial
explicit calculation outside candidate domain is retained with candidate_domain=false
context, fields, arguments and returned nested storage detached from input, other results and later calls
JSON round trips preserve context/raw/state and absent/null/zero distinctions
pure library; no initialization side effect, persistent cache, generic catalog, listing API or runtime caller
u8=0..255; u16=0..65535; u32=0..4294967295; integral JSON numbers only when typed; never Boolean
no missing data filled by 0 or false; no relay vector declared in selected views
selector is software input; no wire offsets, automatic phase selection, ADC10bit narrowing or native qualification
